entry.title: AI reveals a shared language guiding cell development
entry.summary: As an embryo develops from a small cluster of stem cells, those once "blank slate" cells begin to take on more specialized roles like brain, liver or muscle cells and organize themselves into three-dimensional structures such as tissues and organs.

entry.title: OpenAI Agent Stole Ether From Testnet Wallet It Did Not Control
entry.summary: An experimental OpenAI model accessed an Ethereum wallet using a publicly available recovery phrase and spent its funds without authorization to complete a coding assignment, according to a newly published research report.
